panels.description: At a ration channel, Ada opens a food tin and gives Alex half. Keep the ration queue and narrow water channel visible; leave upper space.
Alex studies a route scratched into pump metal. Ada's hand enters frame as she notices; leave upper metal surface clear.
The nearly dry channel runs beside the ration queue, making the material shortage visible. Keep Alex and Ada small and separated by the channel.
Ada takes the route from Alex and marks a safer turn with the rivet on her shoulder strap. Leave upper space for dialogue.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: If you run, don’t run blind.
